title: Flat35 in November: read both stages of the illustration
summary: JHF shows a conditional 2.81% first-five-year illustration, then 3.81%. The introductory figure depends on four discount points.

takeaways.text: JHF’s November illustration is conditional, not a universal borrower quote.

sections.heading: What the published illustration includes
sections.text: For loan-to-value of 90% or less with new JHF group credit life insurance, the Flat35 illustration shows 2.81% for five years and 3.81% from year six. The initial reduction assumes four points, worth one percentage point. JHF describes these as the most commonly offered rates, not a guaranteed lowest rate.

sections.heading: What remains to check
sections.text: Confirm discount qualification, lender fees, insurance options and the applicable funding-month terms. This baseline does not establish an all-in cost, lender approval or campaign entitlement.

package.eligibility: Subject to Japanese nationality / qualifying Japanese permanent residence, underwriting and eligible housing. This illustration assumes LTV ≤90% and new JHF group credit life insurance.
package.conditions: Four discount points required for the illustrated initial reduction. JHF states Flat35 cannot fund investment-property purchases. Lender-specific fees, loan amount and individual approval have not been verified here; consult the full conditions.
